text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kenyan police shoot dead a suspected gangster and recover 10 guns in security operations in Nairobi and the north eastern town of Garissa.
- High taxation in the beer industry and general poverty are turning the country into a mass brewery for traditional liquors and into an importer of malted beer.
- The Kenya Human Rights Commission says the colonial nature of Kenya Police Force training is responsible for its hostile and malicious attitude towards the Kenyan public.
- A massive mobilisation of police from all over Kenya to the capital has been going on in the last few days in what is believed to be a build-up for a major operation to fight crime.
- A three week stand-off at the Nairobi law courts ends after it is agreed that prisoners staying over lunch hour at the courts will be allowed to eat food delivered by relatives.
- Eight people die when a vehicle they were travelling in rolls several times on the Nairobi-Thika highway.
